description: This script manages and summarizes cost data related to model usage, specifically for CodexBar models. It loads cost data from JSON input or via subprocess, processes daily entries, filters by date ranges, aggregates costs, identifies current or most used models, and generates reports in text or JSON format. It is designed for command-line invocation to provide insights into model costs and usages.
